instruction.text: Decide if a line graph would be useful in these scenarios.

atoms.a: Kevin wants to find out which day of the week he runs the furthest.
Theodosia wants to know what everyone’s favourite sandwich toppings are.
Paula wants to track how much she drinks each day.

instruction.text: Adam wants to track how many hours he spends in school each day. Select the three problems with the graph he constructed.

b: ++There are no values for the y-axis.
++The last part of the line is wrong.
There are too many values on the x-axis.
He spends too little time in school on day 6.

instruction.text: Adam has corrected his graph thanks to your help. Now answer these questions about it.

atoms.a: On what day did Adam spend the most amount of hours in school?
How many more hours did Adam spend in school on day 3 than on day 5?
On how many days did Adam spend at least 6 hours in school?
